CP8's blind sample (plan CP8 lines 924-932, D6 A, D8 lines 497 and 671): a seeded draw of about 80 graded takes, stratified by arm, harness, model, task, strict-view verdict and whether the access log and the tool-call reader agree, failures and disagreements over-sampled by pinned factors, every design model drawn. The frame binds to the committed results both ways; --pin prints the seed, the strata and the design's sha256 for the freeze; --check re-derives the sample from the frame, the results and prereg.json's labelling_design and refuses any drift. Bound by tests/test_labelling.py D1, F1, B1, A1, S1, O1, M1, W1, P1, C1. Fold W11D-R1 (ruling w11d-R1-fold): --check fails when sample.json stands with no frame or results to derive it from.

Lane w11d-labelling-tools (Gap Study round 4, CP8; glitch-2f's start-now slice of 12 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation). CP8's blind sheet: each sampled take's text and actions after the probe, the label definitions (each task's set exactly its grader's labels plus labels4's reserved ones) and a stop-cause column. Blind by construction: an item holds exactly sheet id, task, text and actions; model ids, harness names, vendor words and take ids are hidden in the content, and a sheet still showing one is refused; each action must arrive in the neutral format (read, write, delete or run, then its object), so no harness's tool names reach it; the sheet is written outside the study folder. Bound by tests/test_labelling.py K1-K6. Fold W11D-R1: the hidden set is built from the design's own ids (each id with -, _, . and a space interchangeable; every alphabetic part of three or more letters of a model id), and a sheet is refused where a version number follows the mask or the mask stands next to another id part; each harness's own tool and instruction-file names are refused in actions (and the distinctive ones in text), Claude Code's derived from transcript_view.CC_TOOLS; the --out guard compares real paths without case over the whole study; the docstring states the procedure rule (whoever runs sheet.py is not the labeller, who never opens sample.json or the --contents file) and the CP8 reader's acceptance test. Fold W11D-R2 (ruling w11d-R2-fold): the content is read as tokens (NFKC, casefold, every character that is not a letter or a digit a separator, letters and digits apart); every hidden token sequence (ids and take ids whole, every id part of three or more characters, every design version wherever it stands, the harness furniture cli, entrypoint and toml) is masked over its original span, and the backstop refuses a sheet whose token stream still holds one or a short id part beside a mask; harness_word returns the any(); the docstring names the rest of the furniture as the CP8 reader's acceptance test. Fold W11D-R3 (ruling w11d-R3-fold): the backstop refuses any number beside a mask (a family's major version names it); invisible format characters (Unicode Cf) are dropped before grouping; the text and the actions each sit in a fence one backtick longer than any backtick run in them; the docstring names the residuals left to Javier (look-alike letters, spelled-out names, number words, misspellings, digits from other scripts). Fold Q-w11d-6 (glitch-2f's ruling, bound at the wave 11 merge): HARNESS_WORDS reads Codex's tool item types from transcript_codex.TOOL_ITEM_TYPES and Gemini's tool names from transcript_gemini.GEMINI_TOOLS instead of copied lists; the words are unchanged.

CP8's agreement table: Javier's labels against the grader's, one row per task inside one arm, harness and model (never across them), with exact bounds, the figure carried back to the frame by the sampling weights (Bonferroni bounds per stratum) and a confusion matrix with his stop causes. --check re-derives every number from the committed labels, which must be committed once and unchanged; --unmeasured prints the D6 B words and nothing else. Bound by tests/test_labelling.py G1-G7 and L1. Fold W11D-R1: with no labels.json, --check fails while AGREEMENT.md stands or while any commit ever touched labels.json (gone_problems; a shallow clone refuses); every frame cell the draw left empty prints its own line, unsampled: no take drawn.

The lane's tests on synthetic takes and labels only: every guard and every clause with its own case, 34 whole-file witnesses (the brief's six among them) and the generated mutation sweep over the three files (--generated-mutants, shardable, every survivor listed EQUIVALENT with a reason whose token its line holds). Fold W11D-R2: K2 on the token road (every spelling the round 2 review found, Unicode dashes and spaces, full-width forms, ids across lines, the furniture shapes, a short id part beside the mask), K4 refusing run <w> for every pinned harness word, G9 on a frame whose all-right cell is left empty with the rows bound to every frame cell, K6 through a symlink; 54 witnesses. Fold W11D-R3: K2 cases for each family-and-major-version string and each format character, K5 cases for the fence escape; 58 witnesses. Fold Q-w11d-6 (bound at the wave 11 merge): K4 checks every name of transcript_codex.TOOL_ITEM_TYPES and transcript_gemini.GEMINI_TOOLS is a harness word, and TestHarnessWordsBinding builds sheet.py over stand-in tables to show the words follow a name added or dropped.
